# GeoDesign agent memory

Persistent lessons learned across sessions. Append short, dated, factual notes with `edit_file`.

- (seed) Numbers must come from tools; cite fact IDs [F#]. The verifier rejects untraceable numbers.
- (2026-11-05, session 20261105-073441-08eb, verifier rejection) Write each number with the unit of its fact field (e.g. EUR/MWh, t CO2/yr, MW).
- (2026-11-05, session 20261105-074310-6ad3, verifier rejection) When the user specifies a design, simulate and present exactly that design (every stated capacity, depth and temperature).
- (2026-11-05, session 20261105-081947-5009, verifier rejection) Every number must come from a tool result or the brief; never quote a number that is not in a recorded fact.
- (2026-11-05, session 20261105-084416-fc59, verifier rejection) Recommend only the latest design of the turn, and only after verify_design (stress tests, uncertainty, GEMINI solver) has passed on it.
